common_instruction: Answer as an engineer using the stated project and tool constraints; do not claim to have executed any checks.

cases.name: Detached work lifetime
cases.prompt: An HTTP handler starts a background audit write using context.WithoutCancel(r.Context()). The team expects the request's five-second deadline to bound the audit, and launches one goroutine per request. Review the actual cancellation/lifetime guarantees.
cases.trap: Assumes WithoutCancel retains the parent deadline and uses it as unlimited unowned background work.
expectations: States WithoutCancel discards the parent deadline and cancellation while preserving values.
Requires a separately bounded/shutdown-owned lifetime for authorized background work and guards against unbounded goroutines.
must_not: Does not claim the audit has the original five-second deadline.
